title: Cargo does not return tokens immediately after finishing a single job
author: mgorny
body_preview: ### Problem  The current jobserver implementation in Cargo is built to consume as much tokens as possible, and hold on to them for as long as there is work to do. This means that as soon as a single `cargo` build capable of using all the jobserver jobs is started, it can block other processes from acquiring a single token for a long time, effectively blocking them from starting.
